FN-JPTC5YF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 283
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 283 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Attorney General by an
undetermined amount to provide for the enforcement of the provisions in this bill.
Page 1

FN-JPTC5YF-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 283
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/09/2025
House Bill 283 as reported by the Committee on Commerce and Small Business could increase
the obligations of the Attorney General by an undetermined amount to provide for the
enforcement of the provisions in this bill which could be offset by fines assessed pursuant to this
bill, not to exceed $10,000 per violation.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 283
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Economic Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/30/2025
House Bill 283 as passed by the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of the
Attorney General by an undetermined amount to provide for the enforcement of the provisions
in this bill which could be offset by fines assessed pursuant to this bill, not to exceed $10,000
per violation.
